items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: No, I played with him, you know how Celestan was. He kept a fellow a while, you know when he had jobs

ctx.x: Sam says, now, but I wanted to ask you, get back to what we were talking about, all the different things. Were you a regular man with Celestan, a regular member of his band? Did you play with him as a sub?

No, I played with him, you know how Celestan was. He kept a fellow a while, you know when he had jobs, you know what I'm saying? I worked with him a while and then after winding up, he wound up with Albert French.
